 About Glenn Nyberg

 Glenn Nyberg, born on October 12, 1988 in Säter, Sweden, is a Swedish football referee who has gained international recognition. He began his professional career in 2008 and has been officiating in the Allsvenskan, the highest tier of Swedish football, since 2013. In 2016, he was included in the FIFA's list of international referees. Throughout his career, Nyberg has officiated more than 400 matches, including games in European club competitions and national team events.
